readings: Considering only payments that link to a rental record, credit each payment to the staff member who handled that rental (`rental.staff_id`). For each such staff member, return the staff ID, the total payment `amount`, and that total as a fraction of the combined total across all staff members. Do not round anything.
queries:
SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(p2.amount) FROM payment p2 JOIN rental r2 ON p2.rental_id = r2.rental_id) AS fraction
FROM payment p
JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
GROUP BY r.staff_id
